cards.title: The Three Most Important Words in Parenting
cards.body: Tell your child directly and often that you love them—it's the most important gift for security. This simple act can have profound effects on their emotional development and sense of belonging.

cards.title: The Children Are Sponges Idea Is Harmful
cards.body: The 'sponge' metaphor encourages passive learning and blunts children's brain development. Instead, kids thrive when actively engaged and encouraged to think critically.

cards.title: Secure Attachment and Youth Loneliness
cards.body: Gen Z reports the highest loneliness rates and is prone to social media misuse. Secure attachments with caregivers can help prevent these vulnerabilities.

cards.title: Grandparenting Is Wonderful; It's Also Complicated
cards.body: Grandparenting brings joy but also unexpected emotional challenges. Learning to embrace both can strengthen relationships across three generations.

cards.title: Your Child Has Left Home. Now What?
cards.body: Letting your child go is emotional but essential for both of you. Learning when to stop checking up can help them grow into independent adults.

cards.title: The Kindness of Strangers on Family Flights
cards.body: A traveler's stress with four children on an international flight was eased by a passenger's simple kindness. These moments remind us of community support during parenting challenges.

cards.title: Hungry for Connection Through Family Mealtimes
cards.body: Shared meals offer a crucial pause for parents and children to listen and connect. Trading stories at the table builds relationships and family bonds.

cards.title: Should You Tell Kids What's in Your Will?
cards.body: You don't have to reveal your will's contents now, but transparency can prevent family conflict. Unexpected inheritance surprises can tear families apart.

cards.title: My Son Left Home and I Feel Complicated Joy
cards.body: Sending a child to university stirs mixed emotions for parents. Recognizing both the loss and your own freedom can help navigate this milestone.
